description: This file defines the Histograms class in the com.rusefi package, which provides performance and statistical data collection, histogram management, and reporting functionalities used within the project. It includes internal data structures for statistics tracking, histogram calculation, and methods for updating, resetting, and displaying statistical data.

classes.name: Histograms
classes.description: Final class that manages statistical histograms and profiling data within the project.

methods.name: dumpStats
methods.description: Updates total statistics, resets snapshot, and returns a sorted list of string summaries.

methods.name: getCurrentStatistics
methods.description: Returns the current gathered histogram data without resetting.

methods.name: sortAndAddTimes
methods.description: Sorts statistics groups and adds timestamps for display.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Calculates histogram index corresponding to a given value.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a sample value to the histogram statistics under a specific type and name.

methods.name: getCurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a collection of current statistics without resetting data.

methods.name: takeAndResetSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a collection of current statistics and clears all local stats.

methods.name: mergeStats
methods.description: Merges source statistics into the target snapshot map.

methods.name: getLocalStats
methods.description: Retrieves or resets the list of local stats depending on the parameter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats numerical values into human-readable strings.

methods.name: appendHeader
methods.description: Appends header information for statistics group display.

methods.name: appendStatistics
methods.description: Appends detailed statistics for a report.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a statistics group into a formatted string.

classes.name: Histograms.Statistics
classes.description: Represents performance statistics for an individual operation, including total value, count, and histogram data.

classes.name: Histograms.StatisticsGroup
classes.description: Groups statistics of the same type, allows adding and merging statistic data.

classes.name: Histograms.ValueType
classes.description: Enum defining different kinds of values tracked in histograms, e.g., INVOCATION.

classes.name: Histograms.LocalStats
classes.description: Encapsulates local statistics storage for thread-safe collection and merging.
